reviews.text:
We were extremely disappointed with the lack of professionalism and commitment of the employee (Brendon?) who assisted us. We had scheduled the assessment the previous week, which was confirmed to us in writing (WhatsApp). When we arrived for the trial assessment, the employee did not have the appointment and even refused to confirm it with his superior.

There are thousands of nurseries in Lisbon, I definitely do not recommend this one and I am leaving this review only to warn other potential interested parties so that they do not get left in the lurch like we did that day.

This service is completely inadvisable.

They retain payments for services not rendered after cancellation and refuse to issue refunds, ignoring attempts to contact them.

In addition to the lack of financial transparency, there is a clear lack of care and attention to the well-being of the animals.

When questioned about hair loss on my dog, a matter discussed several times with the staff, the owner claimed ignorance and even tried to blame me.

A complete lack of professionalism and responsibility.

Beware of advance payments and your animals.

If you love your dogs, avoid this place.

Flawless. I leave my dog ​​there for daycare 4 days a week and he also stayed at a boarding facility this summer, and it was a very good experience. It was the first time he didn't come back from vacation, so I was a little apprehensive, especially because of what you read more and more on the internet, but everything went perfectly. I highly recommend it, especially for people who don't feel comfortable leaving their dog with strangers.
I visited the place in person. Super cool, spacious, and the staff are definitely super cool professionals. I highly recommend it. 🐕🐕‍🦺🥰 …

My dog goes here twice a week for daycare and has also stayed overnight. The team is amazing. They’re friendly, caring, and they send photo updates to let me know how my dog is doing. He always comes home happy and tired. Since starting, he’s gotten better at socialising with other dogs and even improved his obedience. He absolutely loves it here, and so do I!
Very nice and clean space. I wouldn't put my dog ​​anywhere else.

Absolutely exceptional! My dog ​​goes there for boarding and it's always exceptional!

I highly recommend it.
There's no better place for your dog to be happy 🐶 …
Thank you so much for your trust! 😊 …

Simply the best! Georgia had never been to doggy daycare before and was very unsure, the ladies made her feel so welcome. Soon she looked forward to going and playing and was excited to see the staff. We also used the Hotel 3 times during our stay in Lisbon. Georgia loved it and was treated like a queen. We got lots of updates so we felt reassured and the best part was she came home exhausted from so much playing!! Highly recommend!!!  ❤️❤️❤️

Good morning, we want to thank you for everything you did for our Yara. The care you took of our dear friend during her stay at your hotel! 🤗🤗
Perhaps you could start thinking about having a pick-up and drop-off service for our furry friends! 🙂
Thank you …

I've left my dogs with Teresa several times and will continue to do so! The new daycare facilities are great! Super clean, organized, and above all, effective at caring for the dogs. I highly recommend it!!!
A spacious area for our four-legged friends to play, learn new tricks and skills to develop physically and mentally, and be pampered with a bath and grooming.
A welcoming environment where our dog feels confident, comfortable, and loved!
